inlines.v: UNIV'OCAL, adjective [Latin unus, one, and vox, word.] 1. Having one meaning only. A univocal word is opposed to an equivocal, which has two or more significations. 2. Having unison of sounds; as the octave in music and its replicates. 3. Certain; regular; pursuing always one tenor. [Little used.]
